snp1.9:1.1:
Sātāgira the yakkha:
Today is the fifteenth,
the uposatha day.
snp1.9:1.3: A divine night is at hand.
snp1.9:2.1:
Hemavata the yakkha:
Is his mind well-directed,
snp1.9:3.1:
Sātāgira the yakkha:
His mind is well-directed
snp1.9:4.1:
Hemavata the yakkha:
Does he not take what’s not given?
snp1.9:5.1:
Sātāgira the yakkha:
He doesn’t take what’s not given,
snp1.9:5.5: awakened, he does not neglect jhāna.
snp1.9:6.1:
Hemavata the yakkha:
Does he not tell lies?
snp1.9:6.3: Do his ways of speaking not cut things off?
snp1.9:7.1:
Sātāgira the yakkha:
He doesn’t tell lies.
snp1.9:7.3: His ways of speaking don’t cut things off.
snp1.9:7.5: Deliberating, he speaks what’s of benefit.
snp1.9:8.1:
Hemavata the yakkha:
Is he not passionate for sensuality?
snp1.9:8.5:
Does he have an Eye
with regard to phenomena?
snp1.9:9.1:
Sātāgira the yakkha:
He’s not passionate for sensuality.
snp1.9:9.4: He has gone beyond all delusion.
snp1.9:9.5:
Awakened, he has an Eye
with regard to phenomena.
snp1.9:10.1:
Hemavata the yakkha:
Is he consummate in clear-knowing?
snp1.9:10.3: Is he pure in his conduct?
snp1.9:10.5: Does he have no further becoming?
snp1.9:11.1:
Sātāgira the yakkha:
He is both consummate in clear-knowing
snp1.9:12.1:
Hemavata the yakkha:
Consummate the mind of the sage
snp1.9:12.2: in action & in ways of speech,
snp1.9:12.3:
you rightly praise him
as consummate in clear-knowing & conduct.
snp1.9:13.1: Consummate the mind of the sage
snp1.9:13.2: in action & in ways of speech,
snp1.9:13.3:
you rightly rejoice in him
as consummate in clear-knowing & conduct.
snp1.9:14.1: Consummate the mind of the sage
snp1.9:14.2:
in action & in ways of speech,
let’s go see Gotama,
snp1.9:15.1:
enlightened,
with legs like an antelope, thin,
snp1.9:16.1:
Having gone to the nāga,
the lion wandering alone,
snp1.9:16.4:
about release from Death’s snare.
Let’s ask Gotama,
snp1.9:17.2:
attained to the far shore
of all phenomena:
snp1.9:18.1:
Hemavata the yakkha:
In what has the world arisen?
snp1.9:18.3: In what does it make acquaintance?
snp1.9:18.5:
is the world?
In what is the world
afflicted?
snp1.9:19.1:
The Buddha:
In six has the world arisen.
snp1.9:19.3: In six does it make acquaintance.
snp1.9:19.5:
is the world,
in six is the world
afflicted.
snp1.9:20.1:
Hemavata the yakkha:
Which is that clinging
snp1.9:20.3: When asked the way leading out, please tell
snp1.9:20.4:
how is one released
from suffering & stress.
snp1.9:21.1:
The Buddha:
The five strings of sensuality in the world,
snp1.9:21.2: with the heart described as the sixth:
snp1.9:21.4:
That’s how one’s released
from suffering & stress.
snp1.9:22.1: That is the way leading out of the world
snp1.9:22.2: proclaimed to you as it really is,
snp1.9:22.4:
That’s how one is released
from suffering & stress.
snp1.9:23.1:
Hemavata the yakkha:
Who here crosses
over the flood?
snp1.9:23.2:
Who here crosses
over the ocean?
snp1.9:23.4:
who doesn’t sink
into the deep?
snp1.9:24.1:
The Buddha:
Always consummate in virtue,
snp1.9:24.4:
one crosses over the flood
hard to cross.
snp1.9:25.3: having totally ended delight in becoming,
snp1.9:25.4:
one doesn’t sink
into the deep.
snp1.9:26.1:
Hemavata the yakkha:
The one deeply discerning,
seeing the subtle goal,
snp1.9:26.2:
having nothing,
unattached in sensual becoming:
snp1.9:26.4: the great seer, going the divine way!
snp1.9:27.1:
Perfectly named,
seeing the subtle goal,
snp1.9:27.2:
granting discernment,
unattached to sensual nostalgia:
snp1.9:27.4: the great seer, going the noble way!
snp1.9:28.3: that we saw the One Self-Awakened,
snp1.9:29.3: all go to you for refuge.
snp1.9:30.2:
from village to village,
town to town,
snp1.9:30.3: paying homage to the One Self-Awakened
